captions.detailed: An internally routed dropper seatpost featuring a matte black lower outer sleeve, a matching guide collar, and a telescoping silver inner post. The base has a cable routing pivot, while the top of the inner post is capped with a collar. Mounted to the top is a black cartridge clamp with side bolts and a two-bolt cradle holding a flat, firm black saddle with metallic rails. The inner post telescopically slides vertically inside the lower sleeve to adjust the saddle height.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an internally routed telescoping dropper seatpost with a flat black saddle. The assembly should feature a black outer lower sleeve, a silver inner post that translates vertically, and a detailed rail-clamped saddle at the top.
captions.factory: Construct the lower outer post using a cylinder with a base pivot block and a guide collar at the top. Model the telescoping inner post as a narrower cylinder concentric with the outer post, capped with an upper collar. Build the saddle clamp assembly by combining a horizontal bracket, side bolts, and a rail cradle. Design the saddle by extruding a flat, tapered profile with rounded edges and adding thin metallic sweeps for the rails. Assemble the parts using a prismatic joint to allow vertical telescoping movement of the inner post.
